rationale: Timeline writer-authority change that crosses this family through exactly one path: docs/status/cli-commands.yaml, which the family claims because the design-import commands are catalogued in the same manifest as every other CLI command. The diff adds the seq writer-profile rows to that shared manifest and changes nothing about design import. The design-import command entries in that file are untouched, and no file under tools/import-design, tools/cli/import_*, tools/mcp/**/*design*, templates/**/*design* or docs/**/*design-import* is in the diff; the selector match is the manifest itself, not any design surface. The substance of the change is elsewhere: a named WriterProfile (proposal, editor, trusted) that binds the offline CLI and MCP timeline writers to an explicit capability mask and retention quota, so a proposal-class writer is refused by name instead of by an unnamed default, and every refusal projects a typed conflict code. The MCP tool schema gains the writer_profile selector; timeline-mcp-drift guards that projection and was proven to fail on a mutated artifact and pass on the committed one. Registered as watch-only so the family's coverage stays honest about a change that crossed its selector. No authority moves and no Vellum artifact changes.
